_fixture: Invented screen data for the parday screen family (parday/prepare, parday/perform, parday/arm). No model was called, no engine ran, no limit was measured. It only adds what fixtures/parday.json (read-only, owned by the parday component family) does not carry: the Prepare welcome and context disclosure, the undo acknowledgement, the monthly limit, the thermal pause, the Stop automation acknowledgement and the cancelled-before-start receipt. Times continue the parday.json timeline (now 21:21:48 in Perform).

welcome.text: Ask me to build a crate, draft cues or explain a route. I propose; nothing is saved until you choose Apply to preparation, and saved changes can be undone. In Perform I only read and propose until you arm a specific plan.

context.title: What ParDay can see
context.lead: Only the fields below go into a request, and only for the task you ask about. No audio, artwork, lyrics, file paths or credentials are sent.

included.text: BPM, key, duration and grid confidence of eligible local tracks
included.label: Measured · analysis

included.text: Your tags, ratings, cue names and crate names
Release year and label for tracks you looked up

excluded.text: SODA LIGHTS (Radio Edit) — title, artist, album and popularity from Spotify
excluded.label: Spotify fields excluded

excluded.text: SODA LIGHTS (Extended) — candidate match and release date from Spotify
excluded.label: Spotify fields excluded

context.rule: Spotify-derived fields are excluded from ParDay’s context by default — from prompts, ranking and memory. They stay visible in your library; ParDay simply does not use them. A track you imported yourself is eligible by its own measured fields.
context.provider: Requests go to your direct API key (fixture provider). Retention follows that provider’s settings; this app does not promise zero retention.

costLimit.headline: Monthly AI limit reached — set in Settings; preparation continues manually.
costLimit.detail: US$15.00 of the US$15.00 monthly limit you set. New model requests stop until 1 November or until you raise the limit. Local search, saved proposals, readiness checks and every manual edit keep working.

thermal.headline: ParDay is paused under thermal pressure.
thermal.detail: The phone is hot, so optional conversational work stopped first. Playback, analysis already saved, your crates and every manual control are unaffected. ParDay resumes when the phone cools; nothing queued will run by itself.
